subject: Clearview Health - Discovery recap & EoQ timing check

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearview Health - Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Eleanor / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: support Clearview’s patient-data summarization use case (clinical notes -> anonymized summaries) while ensuring PHI controls and auditability.
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence + VPC deployment option for sensitive pipelines; target latency < 400ms for 512-token requests.
- Success metric: pilot -> 100k tokens/day with 95th pct latency SLA for the pilot group.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Redwood: provide pilot quote + SOC2 snapshot, sample VPC deployment runbook — by 6/22 (attachment: redwood-pricing.pdf).
2) Clearview: share procurement checklist & expected decision date — by 6/24.
3) Joint: schedule technical onboarding call (30m) to validate VPC/network requirements — week of 6/29.

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (attached stubs).

If that looks right, I’ll send the formal quote and a Calendly link for the onboarding call. Anything I missed?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147
